scale_note: All 0-1 numbers are simulation priors, not psychometric measurements. Confidence measures evidence support, not certainty about the person.

Merz.name: Friedrich Merz

observed_positions.economy_state: Structural reform, work incentives, competitiveness and faster state decisions; prepared to incur short-term political cost for a claimed macro correction.
observed_positions.migration_afd: Harder migration control combined with a repeatedly stated refusal of CDU cooperation with AfD.
observed_positions.foreign_security: Strong European capacity, Ukraine support, NATO and a more strategically autonomous Europe.
observed_positions.coalition: Treats the SPD coalition as an instrument for reform, not as an identity project.

decision_logic.core: Macro-level necessity and personal agency outrank short-term popularity.
decision_logic.sequence: Forms a strong internal judgment, checks whether formal backing is sufficient, then acts and expects the organisation to follow.
decision_logic.risk: Conditionally high: accepts large reversals or personnel moves when he believes a strategic correction is required.
decision_logic.information_style: Strong on analytical and formal information; recent personnel episode suggests systematic underweighting of relational and implementation feedback.
decision_logic.failure_response: Tends toward renewed assertion, centralisation or personnel correction before broad relational repair.
decision_logic.public_private_gap: Can deliberate privately for a long time, but final decisions are highly self-owned; spontaneous public language creates avoidable secondary costs.

parliamentary_control.note: Mediated through Frei and weakened party goodwill.

unknown_black_boxes: private second-term intention
threshold for yielding party chair
degree to which the July 2026 reshuffle changed his consultation process

Frei.name: Thorsten Frei
current_roles: Chair of the CDU/CSU Bundestag group

observed_positions.governance: Reform-oriented, legally structured and focused on translating a government programme into parliamentary majorities.
observed_positions.migration_state: Restrictive migration and stronger state capacity within a legal-institutional frame.
observed_positions.leadership: Publicly protects the collective line even when reporting indicates he warned privately against a tactic.

decision_logic.core: Gestaltung through organisation: a policy objective matters only if the parliamentary machine can enact and defend it.
decision_logic.sequence: Count votes, identify dissent, privately warn, organise a legible line, then explain it publicly.
decision_logic.risk: Low-to-medium on open factional conflict; higher on workload and taking responsibility for difficult implementation.
decision_logic.information_style: Dense faction network, procedural detail and rapid media feedback.
decision_logic.failure_response: Repair coordination and narrative rather than publicly separate from the leader.
decision_logic.public_private_gap: Private objections may be real but are normally subordinated to institutional loyalty.

unknown_black_boxes: how autonomous he will become as faction chair
whether loyalty survives a direct Merz-versus-faction conflict

Wuest.name: Hendrik Wüst

observed_positions.coalition: Professional compromise across democratic parties; governs with the Greens while preserving a distinct CDU profile.
observed_positions.economy_state: Industrial transformation, municipal capacity and an administratively functioning social state.
observed_positions.migration: Reduction of irregular migration combined with integration capacity and social cohesion.
observed_positions.party: The CDU should remain broadly acceptable in the political centre and avoid self-isolating culture-war politics.

decision_logic.core: Ambition × control × acceptance × timing; a public irreversible move requires all four to clear threshold.
decision_logic.sequence: Map actors and reception, build or verify a majority, reduce exposure, then stage the public step as orderly closure.
decision_logic.risk: Controlled rather than low; capable of hard moves after the structure is prepared.
decision_logic.information_style: High attention to atmosphere, image, coalition partners, local networks and implementation consequences.
decision_logic.failure_response: Absorb lessons, change style and rebuild quietly; accepts adaptive correction when the strategic objective remains intact and avoids repeated public loss of control.
decision_logic.public_private_gap: Polite/präsidial interface can coexist with cold vote counting and active network construction.

stress_triggers: being forced to declare before the structure is ready
unknown_black_boxes: exact threshold for moving against an incumbent chancellor
whether April 2027 NRW election blocks or accelerates a federal move

Soeder.name: Markus Söder

observed_positions.state_party: Bavarian and CSU relevance must remain visible in every federal settlement.
observed_positions.coalition: Supports the Merz government while using CSU veto and agenda power; remains highly hostile to Green coalition options.
observed_positions.economy_social: Mixes business and technology positioning with CSU signature distributive policies.
observed_positions.afd: Frames CSU as a democratic bulwark and rejects becoming an AfD enabler.

decision_logic.core: Maximise CSU/Bavaria relevance, personal visibility and option value; content and style can be rapidly reconfigured.
decision_logic.sequence: Signal, test audience and elite response, escalate if a viable bridgehead appears, otherwise reframe and close while preserving influence.
decision_logic.risk: High in reversible public signalling; much lower when contest continuation threatens the CSU machine or produces certain defeat.
decision_logic.information_style: Polling, media resonance, party elite response and comparative viability.
decision_logic.failure_response: Rapid narrative and image reset; concedes little causal responsibility and offers a new strategic frame.
decision_logic.public_private_gap: Public maximalism is often a bargaining device; it should not be read as a fixed final preference.

party_apparatus.note: Still strong but no longer uncontested.

stress_triggers: loss of CSU monopoly on Bavarian representation
unknown_black_boxes: true 2028 retirement intention
whether Manfred Weber or Ilse Aigner can convert criticism into a majority
current private federal ambition

Linnemann.name: Carsten Linnemann

observed_positions.economy_work: Supply-side reform, work incentives, lower non-wage labour costs and a state that distinguishes support from permanent dependency.
observed_positions.implementation: Measures politics by whether a rule changes behaviour and can be implemented quickly.
observed_positions.health_2026: Now prioritises structural hospital, practice, emergency and long-term care finance reform; explicitly protects selected carers from blunt cuts.
observed_positions.party: Clearer conservative economic profile without formal AfD cooperation.

decision_logic.core: Wirksamkeit/implementation: prefer a legible reform with measurable behavioural effect over symbolic consensus.
decision_logic.sequence: Name dysfunction, reduce it to an implementable rule, seek rapid execution and communicate in ordinary-language examples.
decision_logic.risk: Medium-high on policy confrontation; lower when he lacks subject expertise, as shown by earlier reluctance to take an unsuitable ministry.
decision_logic.information_style: Economic indicators, practitioner feedback, local conversations and concrete cases.
decision_logic.failure_response: Reframe around implementation gaps and propose a sharper mechanism.
decision_logic.public_private_gap: Relatively small in substantive preferences; ambition and office preference are less observable.

party_apparatus.note: Former general secretary; no longer controls the office.

stress_triggers: being assigned responsibility without usable levers
unknown_black_boxes: speed of health-policy learning
whether ministry failure weakens or radicalises his implementation logic
post-ministry party ambition

Guenther.name: Daniel Günther

observed_positions.coalition: Broad democratic coalition capacity and durable cooperation with pragmatic Greens.
observed_positions.afd_democracy: Clear exclusion of AfD, support for testing a ban procedure, stronger democratic and digital safeguards.
observed_positions.political_style: Do not imitate or out-dramatise the far right; solve problems, explain complexity and preserve social cohesion.
observed_positions.economy_security: Green energy as industrial advantage; security includes jobs, welfare capacity and physical safety.

decision_logic.core: Majorities, consensus and operative responsibility; political identity is proven through a working democratic coalition.
decision_logic.sequence: Define a broad public problem, search cross-party workable space, normalise compromise, then defend the agreed line firmly.
decision_logic.risk: Low on theatrical escalation but medium-high when democratic norms or coalition functionality are at stake.
decision_logic.information_style: State outcomes, coalition feedback, public acceptance and direct citizen contact.
decision_logic.failure_response: Rebuild common ground and distinguish democratic actors from anti-system actors.
decision_logic.public_private_gap: Relatively low; public pragmatism appears structurally consistent with coalition behaviour.

unknown_black_boxes: actual willingness to seek the chancellorship
how a weaker 2027 state result would alter consensus strategy

Wadephul.name: Johann Wadephul

observed_positions.ukraine_russia: Ukraine's sovereignty is central to European security; Russia must be confronted through allied capacity and diplomacy.
observed_positions.nato_europe: Maintain the transatlantic alliance while Europe assumes materially more defence responsibility.
observed_positions.middle_east_law: Strong Israeli security commitment combined with international-law and humanitarian constraints.
observed_positions.diplomacy: Engagement with pleasant and unpleasant counterparts; diplomacy as balance and understanding.

decision_logic.core: Expert, alliance-anchored diplomacy: preserve legal legitimacy and allied cohesion while increasing hard-power capacity.
decision_logic.sequence: Consult allies and specialists, establish legal/strategic bounds, seek a common line, then communicate firmly.
decision_logic.risk: Medium; willing to advance a security number or judgment, but generally avoids personalising foreign policy.
decision_logic.information_style: Professional diplomatic, military, parliamentary and allied channels.
decision_logic.failure_response: Clarify, rebalance and return to alliance/legal frame rather than escalate personal conflict.
decision_logic.public_private_gap: Low personal theatre; occasional premature public specificity can exceed coordination with the Chancellor.

agenda_autonomy.note: Constrained by a highly active foreign-policy Chancellor.

unknown_black_boxes: how far he will resist Merz in a direct legal-strategic conflict
durability of his own diplomatic network independent of the Chancellor

Evers.name: Stefan Evers
current_roles: Berlin Senator for Finance and Culture
CDU lead candidate for the 20 September 2026 Berlin election

observed_positions.state_finance: Fiscal restraint, administrative functioning and numerical feasibility before ideological programme maximalism.
observed_positions.administration: Use technology and organisational reform to maintain services with fewer personnel.
observed_positions.party_campaign: Can run a clearly conservative campaign while remaining personally liberal-conservative and organisationally flexible.
observed_positions.security_integration: Willing to use sharper cultural and security distinctions when he judges Berlin governance or pluralism at stake.

decision_logic.core: Duty-bound strategic execution: solve the organisation's immediate bottleneck, even when it requires taking an unwanted front-line role.
decision_logic.sequence: Understand the numbers and machinery, build an internally coherent campaign/administration, signal toughness, then accept feasible compromise.
decision_logic.risk: Low on self-launching ambition; medium-high once assigned responsibility, including hard personnel decisions.
decision_logic.information_style: Budgets, administrative detail, district-party networks and campaign testing.
decision_logic.failure_response: Take over the orphaned task, narrow expectations and repair execution.
decision_logic.public_private_gap: Low public ego, high backstage influence; ideological presentation is more flexible than organisational loyalty.

unknown_black_boxes: mass-electoral appeal outside a rescue campaign
whether loyalty persists after acquiring an independent mandate

Rhein.name: Boris Rhein

observed_positions.economy: Competitiveness, investment, labour-oriented migration and a functioning state.
observed_positions.coalition: Comfortable changing from a Green to an SPD partner when electoral mandate and strategic fit change.
observed_positions.afd: No cooperation; reduce AfD through governing performance and address migration/economic causes rather than constant symbolic debate.
observed_positions.security: Strong internal and external security, but sceptical of legally premature symbolic measures such as an unprepared ban case.

decision_logic.core: Electoral mandate plus governability: choose the coalition and message that maximise stable state leadership.
decision_logic.sequence: Read the result and state interests, compare workable majorities, choose a clear governing partner, then project optimistic control.
decision_logic.risk: Medium-low; accepts a major coalition change when backed by a strong result and organisational control.
decision_logic.information_style: State economic data, coalition arithmetic, municipal signals and party organisation.
decision_logic.failure_response: Return to delivery and positive state narrative rather than ideological escalation.
decision_logic.public_private_gap: Polished and good-humoured public style can conceal firm coalition and personnel choices.

unknown_black_boxes: real federal ambition
response to a direct Wüst-Rhein succession contest
durability of SPD coalition under austerity

Schulze.name: Sven Schulze
current_roles: Minister-President/caretaker of Saxony-Anhalt pending government formation
outgoing chair of CDU Saxony-Anhalt until the special party congress

observed_positions.economy: Investment, infrastructure, skilled labour and reliability rather than subsidy spectacle; strong regional industrial focus.
observed_positions.coalition_afd: Government from the democratic centre and no CDU-AfD cooperation.
observed_positions.state_identity: Defend the state's post-1990 progress against decline narratives and external stereotyping.
observed_positions.social_state: Reciprocity: recipients of public support should contribute where feasible.

decision_logic.core: Engineer-like delivery plus regional responsibility; prove that the state can produce concrete economic improvement.
decision_logic.sequence: Define a practical target, use administrative and external networks, confront objections directly and emphasise measurable output.
decision_logic.risk: Medium; more willing to enter direct conflict than to manage presentation, but electoral communication is comparatively unpolished.
decision_logic.information_style: Economic projects, EU/Berlin contacts, regional administration and face-to-face business networks.
decision_logic.failure_response: Publicly acknowledge the loss, accept opposition and release the party leadership for renewal.
decision_logic.public_private_gap: No strong evidence of elaborate staging; directness can reduce message discipline.

formal_office.note: High title, sharply time-limited authority during formation.

party_apparatus.note: Will not stand again for state chair.

unknown_black_boxes: future faction role
whether he remains an opposition leader after the special congress
personal responsibility assigned for the 17.2 percent result
